description: All scheduled unlocks in the next 60 days for one token, with recipients (team, investors, treasury ...), USD value, share of circulating supply, futures availability and a link to the token page. Accepts a ticker (ARB), a name (Arbitrum) or a slug (arbitrum). Matching is exact: matched_by says whether the ticker, the slug or the name matched. A partial match never selects a token; close names come back in did_you_mean. coverage tells three cases apart: in_calendar (unlocks listed); known_no_unlock (we track this token and it has no unlock in the next 60 days, found=0, not an error); unknown_token (the token is not in our data: this is NOT evidence that it has no unlocks, say that we do not cover it). disputed=true on an unlock means the project's own documents give a different amount or date; dispute_summary has both versions and both must be reported. If the result mentions onchain_check, call get_onchain_check to see what the locked wallets are doing. recipient_selling_habit (when present) says how often recipients of this coin's past unlocks sold within 7 days; it is reference only and did not predict price. lang=ru returns Russian page links.
name: get_token_unlocks
title: Unlocks for one token
